entries.issue: The official geotechnical and seismic-response map layers were not ingested because the product brief excludes GIS automation. A manually selected zone must be verified by the responsible professional.
entries.disposition: No coordinate-to-zone lookup is authorized; the supported workflow is explicit manual zone selection with the regulatory warning.

entries.issue: The SISJUR page contains later amendment annotations elsewhere in the compiled decree.
entries.disposition: The retrieved current text showed no amendment annotation attached to Title 1 Articles 2–10; re-check the current official page at product activation.

entries.issue: Copyright and dynamic-page constraints prevent bundling source bytes.
entries.disposition: Independent reviewer must re-fetch and verify the committed URL/length/SHA-256 locks.

entries.issue: The two rasters committed under public/bogota render the Mapa No 2 annex sheet, which the study's redistribution policy would otherwise class as a prohibited rendered source page. The sheet is an annex of Decreto Distrital 523 de 2010 rather than the FOPAE report, but redistribution permission was not established.
entries.disposition: The product owner decided to ship them: without the sheet the engineer cannot see which of the 16 zones a coefficient came from, which is the point of the traceability drawer. The exception is scoped in redistribution.json and stays open for independent review to revisit; the fallback remains the outbound link to the decree.

entries.issue: No official publisher URL is established for the annex sheet. It is retrievable from the espectrocol.com mirror at https://www.espectrocol.com/mapas/bogota_respuesta.pdf, which returns exactly the locked 3825830 bytes and SHA-256 43f9f58b…, and its embedded metadata (SDP, 2010-12-16, «Respuesta_2010») is consistent with the official sheet — but a mirror is not the publisher.
entries.disposition: Kept out of source-locks.json, which stays a three-source manifest of officially-served bytes; the mirror URL and hash live in data/map-evidence.json so a reviewer can reproduce the crops today. Independent review must still locate the publisher URL before activation.
